rows.grounds: Compound adjective qualifying the hundred names named in the previous verse; grants all desires and purposes.
Denotes the recipients of the benefits conferred by the hundred names.
Compound adjective qualifying the hundred names; conveys the bringing of happiness.

items.question: What desires and happiness does the supreme hundred-name hymn bestow on practitioners?
premises: The supreme hundred names grant all desires and aims.
The supreme hundred names bring happiness.
These benefits are bestowed upon practitioners.
items.inference: Therefore the supreme hundred-name hymn fulfills practitioners' desires and confers happiness upon them.
uncertainties: The adjectives are read as qualifying nāma+aṣṭa+śatam from the preceding verse.
items.plain_english: O goddess, it grants all desires and aims and brings happiness to practitioners.
